title: The On Air and Movement session engines load only when the overlay opens
detail: OnAirSession (110 KB source) and MovementSession (76 KB) are static imports of the shell, parsed on every (main) route. Wrap in dynamic(). Estimated 30-40 KB gzip. Confirm with check:shell-weight on a build.

verify.note: Exits 0 only when the repair has landed; fails on main today.
